edge.title: Muon→AdamH: Adam direction applied on a fixed-norm hyperball
edge.summary: All 72 hidden block matrices switch from Muon + weight decay to AdamH: a bias-corrected Adam direction m̂/(√v̂+1e-8) (betas 0.9/0.95) is rescaled to Frobenius norm lr·‖W‖_F, subtracted, and W is renormalized back to its pre-step norm, so every hidden matrix stays on a sphere of its init radius and weight decay is dropped. Because a zero matrix would be stuck at radius 0, the residual projections are no longer zero-initialized: attn.proj, mlp.proj and mlp.fc get ×1.25, ×3.0 and ×1.5 the default Kaiming-uniform init. The hidden lr (0.018) warms up linearly over 250 steps and otherwise decays linearly to 0 over the whole run, while aux AdamW (unchanged LRs) cools down over the last 40%; the run needs 4875 steps.

changes.label: AdamH hidden-matrix direction
changes.detail: AdamH.step keeps per-element exp_avg/exp_avg_sq (betas (0.9, 0.95)) with bias correction and forms update = m̂/(√v̂ + 1e-8), replacing Muon's Nesterov momentum + Newton–Schulz for every block matrix.

changes.label: Hyperball (norm-preserving) step
changes.detail: scale_invariant_update_: W' = W − lr·U·‖W‖/max(‖U‖,1e-10), then W ← W'·‖W‖/max(‖W'‖,1e-10); the pre-retraction step is exactly lr·‖W‖_F and ‖W‖_F never changes, so hidden weight decay (0.01) is removed.

changes.label: Non-zero per-module init
changes.detail: Default nn.Linear init is kept and scaled: attn.proj.weight ×1.25, mlp.proj.weight ×3.0, mlp.fc.weight ×1.5 (q/k/v ×1). Only the LM head proj.weight and the 'proj' biases are zeroed; #1 zeroed every 'proj' parameter, incl. both residual projections.

changes.label: Hidden-only 250-step LR warmup
changes.detail: set_hparams gives the 'h' (AdamH) group eta = step/250 for step < h_warmup_steps = 250; aux AdamW has no warmup.

changes.label: Split cooldown: hidden 1.0, aux 0.4
changes.detail: After warmup the hidden multiplier is 1 − step/4875 (cooldown_frac 1.0, so warmup lands on the decay line at ≈0.95); aux AdamW stays flat for 60% and decays linearly over the last 40% (was one shared cooldown_frac 0.7).

changes.label: Steps 3600→4875, lr 0.02→0.018
changes.detail: train_steps = 4875 and matrix_lr = 0.018 for AdamH; aux AdamW groups (0.3, 1/320, 0.01) unchanged.

changes.label: Unsharded optimizer + logging
changes.detail: AdamH loops over all params on every rank (no rank sharding / all_gather, no torch.compile); docstring and a device-name log line added.

hparams_changed.label: proj init
hparams_changed.to: LM head + proj biases zero; attn.proj ×1.25, mlp.proj ×3.0 default init

edge.parent_check: consistent — nearest code is #1 (149 changed lines); sibling of #5 (same author) with the identical hyperball helper and init multipliers.
edge.noise: Docstring rewrite, an extra device-name print, and dropping Muon's rank-sharded loop (AdamH runs redundantly on every rank) do not change the math.

techniques.note: AdamH on all 72 block matrices: betas (0.9, 0.95), eps 1e-8, bias-corrected, no wd
each block matrix pinned to its init ‖W‖_F; step = lr·‖W‖ along U/‖U‖, then renormalize
default Kaiming-uniform × attn.proj 1.25, mlp.proj 3.0, mlp.fc 1.5; q/k/v ×1
hidden group only: eta = step/250 for the first 250 steps
hidden: linear to 0 over the whole run (frac 1.0); aux: last 40%
AdamW embed 0.3 / head 1/320 / 1-D 0.01, betas (0.8, 0.95), eps 1e-10, wd 0

hparams.schedule.kind: hidden: 250-step linear warmup, else 1 − step/4875; aux: flat then linear
hparams.hyperball.radius: per-matrix ‖W‖_F at init (expected ≈16 q/k/v, 20 attn.proj, 48 mlp.fc & mlp.proj)
hparams.init.proj: LM head proj.weight = 0; block proj weights non-zero
hparams.init.bias: proj biases 0; q/k/v/fc biases default uniform ±1/√fan_in

mechanisms.name: Hyperball (Frobenius-sphere) step
mechanisms.explain: scale_invariant_update_ takes the optimizer direction U, rescales it to Frobenius norm lr·‖W‖_F (only U's direction survives), subtracts it, and rescales the result back to the pre-step norm ‖W‖_F. Each hidden matrix therefore stays on a sphere whose radius is its norm at initialization: lr is a relative step, the radial part of U is cancelled by the renormalization, and the net move is an angle of about lr along U's tangential component. This replaces weight decay as the norm control.

mechanisms.name: AdamH direction
mechanisms.explain: AdamH keeps standard per-element Adam moments (beta1 0.9, beta2 0.95, bias-corrected, eps 1e-8) for every block matrix and hands m̂/(√v̂+eps) to the hyperball step instead of applying it additively. There is no weight decay, and because the step is renormalized, only the direction of the Adam update matters.

mechanisms.name: Per-module init multipliers
mechanisms.explain: Starting from PyTorch's default nn.Linear init (uniform, std 1/√(3·fan_in)), attn.proj is scaled ×1.25, mlp.proj ×3.0 and mlp.fc ×1.5 (std ≈ 0.026/0.031/0.031) while q/k/v keep std ≈ 0.0208. Since the hyperball freezes each matrix's norm, these multipliers fix the radii for the whole run (expected ‖W‖_F ≈ 16 for q/k/v, 20 for attn.proj, 48 for mlp.fc and mlp.proj).

mechanisms.name: Hidden-group LR warmup
mechanisms.explain: For step < 250 the hidden lr multiplier is step/250 (0 at step 0). After that it is 1 − step/4875, so the warmup ramps into an already-decaying line (≈0.95 at step 250) rather than a plateau.

mechanisms.name: Split cooldown
mechanisms.explain: Param groups are tagged schedule_type 'h' or 'aux'. Hidden matrices use cooldown_frac 1.0 (linear decay over the entire run), while the AdamW embed/head/scalar groups stay flat for 60% and decay linearly to 0 over the last 40%.

caveats: Radii (≈16/20/48) are expected Frobenius norms implied by the init std, not constants in the code. The first hidden step has lr 0 (warmup starts at eta = 0), so AdamH's first call only seeds its moments.
